# Sunflex

Sunflex applies its colour scheme through Obsidian's native colour variables for consistent, readable styling. Light and dark modes are both included, the dark variant being true black, alongside eight semantic palettes covering red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple and pink.

![Sunflex screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunxuecong/Sunflex/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Sunflex"
    author: "Sunflex"
    repo:   "sunxuecong/Sunflex"
    slug:   "sunflex"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/sunflex"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/sunxuecong/Sunflex"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunxuecong/Sunflex/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply the Sunflex color scheme to Obsidian using native color variables for consistent, readable styling. Include light and dark modes with a true-black dark variant and eight semantic color palettes (red, orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink)."
}
```
